setup.intro: What this machine needs, in the order a setup goes. Each step is done on its own screen, or by the command beside it at a terminal.
setup.step.agent.title: An agent
setup.step.agent.when: Done when a tool is installed and an account of it is signed in.
setup.step.helper.title: Ask Daoris's agent
setup.step.helper.when: Done when Ask Daoris has an agent to run on. The agent that answers asks is chosen beside it.
setup.step.repositories.title: A workspace and its repositories
setup.step.repositories.when: Done when a repository is registered. A workspace exists once one is registered in it.
setup.step.driven.title: What is driven
setup.step.driven.when: Done when a repository is driven, so its quests start on this machine.
setup.step.landing.title: How work lands
setup.step.landing.when: Done when every driven repository has a line and a rule for how its work lands, its own or its workspace's.
setup.step.rules.title: What agents may do
setup.step.rules.when: Optional: look over what a session Daoris starts may do. It never holds up the setup.
setup.desktop: An agent, Ask Daoris's agent, what is driven, how work lands and what agents may do are this machine's own: the desktop's Setup shows them.
setup.askNeedsAgent: Ask Daoris can walk you through these once it has an agent to run on: step 2.
setup.ask.message: Walk me through setting up Daoris on this machine, one step at a time. Not done yet: {{steps}}.
